Get Practice and Category Ids

Source: R/samedi_api.R
get_practice_ids.Rd

Translates the practice and category identifiers of the booking page URL (see api_potsdam_config()) into the ids used by the samedi booking API.

Usage

get_practice_ids(config = api_potsdam_config())

Arguments

config

settings as returned by api_potsdam_config()

Value

named list with elements practice_id (character) and event_category_id (integer)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_practice_ids()
} # }
